<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>AIVA & Grace — How a Message Travels</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --ink: #1e293b;
    --muted: #64748b;
    --blue: #4c9fff;
    --blue-dark: #2b6cb0;
    --card: #ffffff;
    --bg: #eef3f8;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--ink);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  header {
    max-width: 1120px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 28px 16px 8px;
  }
  header h1 {
    margin: 0 0 6px;
    font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.4vw, 2.1rem);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  header p {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 2vw, 1.05rem);
  }
  main {
    max-width: 1120px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 16px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 18px;
  }
  .stage {
    background: var(--card);
    border-radius: 16px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.10);
  }
  svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
  svg text { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }

  /* ---- nodes ---- */
  .node { transition: transform 0.3s ease; }
  .node.active { animation: nodePulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes nodePulse {
    0%, 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(76, 159, 255, 0.45)); }
    50%     { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(76, 159, 255, 0.95)); }
  }

  /* ---- arrows ---- */
  .arrow {
    fill: none;
    stroke: #c6d3e1;
    stroke-width: 3;
    stroke-dasharray: 8 6;
    transition: stroke 0.3s ease, stroke-width 0.3s ease;
  }
  .arrow.active {
    stroke: var(--blue);
    stroke-width: 4;
    animation: dashMove 1s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes dashMove { to { stroke-dashoffset: -14; } }

  /* ---- token ---- */
  .token { transition: transform 1s ease; }

  /* ---- streaming dots ---- */
  #stream-dots { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; }
  #router.active #stream-dots { opacity: 1; }
  #stream-dots circle { animation: streamUp 1.2s linear infinite; }
  #stream-dots circle:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
  #stream-dots circle:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.8s; }
  @keyframes streamUp {
    0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0); }
    20%  { opacity: 1
